Connected original flight/environment/lifecycle contracts. BYTEBB9 is FF for normal control but 1 after celestial-body transfer; nonnegative state halves speed/control accumulators and steps rotation0 by6 modulo4096 untilzero, then writesFF. BYTEBBA is cleared by contact collection each frame, receives2 on structure exit or FF/FE on orientation-dependent entry; mouse/player control consumers bypass free flight and force original poses. BYTEBBB enables resuming interruptedgame: gameplay start and successful load set, gameover/viewer/loadstart clear; E3D4 tests it before resuming. Not a pointer-serialization flag. BYTEBB5 is modulo4 divider used solely by nearby Solice update to decrement angle once per4calls, initialized3 on world/newgame. BYTEBB7 is world atmosphere flag: indexed16-byte table37B58 selects FF/0 and eventmessages11/10 say Atmosphere/NoAtmosphere Detected; surface type145 disc overlay also checks it. Unknown higher selector domains and original sideeffects retained. Rotation2 event spin uses signed WORD39CDA (64steps, negativeinactive) and restore WORD39CDC; expiry restores angle and writesFFFF. These static contracts explain original byte states, not new runtime scenarios, universal physical time or all-entry validity. Current C/vasm full-file equality preserves original bytes.

Connected native input/display/panel producer-consumer contracts. Amiga D170 reads mirrored CIAA PRA bit6 active-low into201 and POTINP bit10 active-low into202; alternate packet3B61E writes corresponding button bits1/0.201 drives menu/cancel/start and202 selects mouse-Y speed versus rotation behavior. D170 stores JOY0DAT low/high BYTEs in1FF/200 after signed wrap-delta extraction; viewer initializes those counters and original random-mix38C8 reads them. Their meaning is hardware counter samples, not screen coordinates. BYTE20A is a bitmask: bit0 gates reticle sprite drawing and follows internal/external view; bit1 gates resource HUD; signbit gates selected IRQ motion/message/panel-counter services, whilezero/nonzero gates other services. Preserve startup7F/latebit7/80/0/0E states, not one Boolean or globalpause. BYTE209 is a consumed request: resource-contact/charging and volcano paths set it; panel updater sets reload WORDs3/4 tozero and clears request, else100. WORD7C2 increments in nonmodal signed20A IRQ branch and panel updater tests low BYTE against5 then clears wholeWORD. Not universal frames, no new runtime or physical left/right assertion beyond original primary/secondary button roles. Current canonical base assumptions remain conditional; byte exactness does not establish every input path. Current C/vasm full-file equality preserves original bytes.
